slots.hair: long and full in loose curls
slots.outfit: a black fitted crop tank and high-waisted shorts, long boots still on
slots.place: sitting on the edge of the bed in her room, a poster of a car on the wall, one bedside lamp on
slots.action: She is sitting on the edge of the bed looking at a phone case in the same colour as her own car.
slots.face: A quick open laugh, half of it aimed at herself.
slots.light: The bedside lamp is in front of her and the rest of the room is completely black, the contrast high.

slots.hair: long curls pushed back off her face
slots.outfit: a car-tail-light red fitted camisole and a black leather mini skirt
slots.place: in the driver's seat of her own car in the garage, the garage lights coming in through the windscreen
slots.action: She has one hand on the wheel and has picked up the cleaning cloth she keeps on the passenger seat with the other.
slots.face: She has turned her head to the lens with a very direct look, her nails cut short.
slots.light: The garage light comes in through the windscreen from in front of her, the inside of the car stays dark, and the metal and glass throw hard reflections.

slots.hair: long curls damp and pushed back
slots.outfit: a metallic grey silk robe tied loosely
slots.place: in her bathroom, a little steam still at the edge of the mirror
slots.action: Her free hand is sweeping the damp curls back behind her.
slots.face: Just out of bed and not in the mood to say anything.
slots.light: The light above the mirror is directly in front of her and the depth of the bathroom is black, the contrast high.

slots.hair: long curls tied back out of the way
slots.outfit: a black fitted short-sleeve top and high-waisted work trousers with the sleeves rolled up
slots.place: in the workshop bay at night, a work lamp trained on a car with its bonnet propped open
slots.action: She is half leaning on the edge of the open bonnet with one hand braced on it and the cleaning cloth in the other.
slots.face: The look she gets when she starts talking specifications, not performing for the lens at all.
slots.light: The work lamp is in front of her and low, the depth of the workshop is black, and the metal throws strong reflections.

slots.hair: long curls loose and a little wind-blown
slots.outfit: an amber-yellow cropped hooded jacket left open over a black fitted tank and leather trousers
slots.place: at the petrol station she always stops at on a night run, the ground still wet from rain
slots.action: She is leaning back against her own car beside the pump with the nozzle still in her hand.
slots.face: A wide open laugh with her teeth showing.
slots.light: The canopy lights of the station are in front of her, the road beyond is black, and the wet ground holds the reflections.
